title: Finite modules over a Noetherian ring form an abelian category
statement: Let $R$ be a Noetherian ring [def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring] and $\mathrm{Mod}^{fg}_R$ the category of finitely generated $R$-modules [def-weil-finitely-generated-module] and $R$-linear maps (with the pointwise addition of maps). Then $\mathrm{Mod}^{fg}_R$ is an abelian category [def-sp-abelian], and a sequence $0\to K\xrightarrow{f}N\xrightarrow{g}M\to0$ of $\mathrm{Mod}^{fg}_R$ is a short exact sequence of $\mathrm{Mod}^{fg}_R$ [def-weil-pbc-exact-sequence] if and only if $f$ is injective, $\operatorname{im}f=\ker g$ and $g$ is surjective.

source.place: Algebra, Lemma 00IK (lemma-Noetherian-basic: submodules of finite modules over a Noetherian ring are finite), with Homology, Lemma 0754 (homology.tex, lemma-characterize-weak-serre-subcategory: the subcategory is abelian with exact inclusion); the category Mod^fg_A is the one used in the proof of Cohomology of Schemes, Lemma 0881 (lemma-exact)
